chunks: For those who believe and do the right is forgiveness and gracious provision.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who believe and do righteous deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj is often interpreted as a promise of comprehensive success, where 'generous provision' (rizq karim) is understood not merely as material sustenance but as the ultimate spiritual reward of Paradise and the nearness to the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores the inseparable link between faith (iman) and action (amal), reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of belief and righteous practice in achieving divine mercy.
